title: Trailer for Dark Tactics - PvE Roguelite Autobattler
author: yolomobile
selftext:
Back with another update on Dark Tactics! After sharing screenshots in my [last post](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1wrz6z0/art_style_update_on_dark_tactics_roguelite_pve/), I wanted to show how things look in motion.

It’s a single-player dark fantasy roguelite autobattler. You recruit and merge units, build around synergies, choose your route through different zones, and take on bosses. Between runs, you spend what you’ve earned on permanent upgrades.

There’s still a lot of polish left to do, especially around the UI, visual consistency, and combat readability. But all the major bones are there now, and it’s reached a point where I’m comfortable putting together a short trailer to show what I’m working toward.

I’m still using AI heavily across the project, with plenty of iteration along the way. The feedback on the previous posts has been helpful, particularly about the art and UI, and I’m continuing to work on those.

Would love your honest first impressions. Does the trailer give you a clear sense of the game? What looks interesting, and what immediately needs more work? First thing I'll focus on is the UI for the upgrade tree, looks like shit.

Appreciate everyone who’s been following along.
